g.text: Source-reported coverage; no cell establishes complete participant coverage.
● Reported in publication/resource ◆ Official description only — Unreported in reviewed
Digital includes iPOP self-report. Functional includes metabolic challenges. UK Biobank
perturbation is subset exercise testing, not assigned therapy. Neural means brain measurement;
cognitive tests alone do not establish neural sensing. HPP is abstract-only; ELITE is public
